title: LS-MDRM Evidence–Claim Ledger Schema
description: Schema for recording the full Claim → Inference → Evidence → Corpus Version chain for every material proposition.

bound_repository_commit.description: All repository-backed evidence bindings default to this commit unless a more specific historical binding overrides.

claim_status.description: Epistemic status at the time this ledger entry is created. Must not be retroactively upgraded.

prior_claim_status.description: If this entry records a status transition, the prior status. Null if first assignment.

promotion_licensed.description: If claim_status is stronger than prior_claim_status, whether the promotion is explicitly licensed by a rule. Null if no transition.

promotion_license_rule.description: Citation to the rule or evidence that licenses the promotion. Required if promotion_licensed=true.

EPR_contribution.description: True if this entry contributes an unlicensed promotion to the EPR numerator.

inference_path.description: Transformation rule or logical path from evidence to claim.

exact_location.description: Section, line range, field path, or other precise locator within the artifact.

counterevidence.description: Summary of known counterevidence or null if none documented.

limitations.description: Known limitations on the claim's scope or inferential strength.

uncertainty.description: Sources and nature of uncertainty affecting this claim.
